name: openclaude-vscode
description: Simple integration to send file contents to a local OpenClaude HTTP endpoint and apply edits.

openclaude.endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint URL for your local OpenClaude server

openclaude.instruction.default: You are an expert code assistant. Return the full new file content as plain text.
openclaude.instruction.description: System instruction/preprompt sent to the model before the file contents

openclaude.authToken.description: Optional Bearer token for authentication (or use OPENCLAUDE_AUTH_TOKEN env var)
